Traffic car block-outs

The seven 1980s civilian cars (survey J7) at true size beside the pilot (1.8 m) and the Foreman (24 m), on the 24 m street they drive. Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom; arrow keys and +/- also work.

Block-out stand-ins: flat colours, no textures, no LODs. Awaiting approval before the detailed models.

Show

State

Crushed and burnt are how the game shows a wreck until the crushed variants are modelled: crushed is the block-out pressed to 35 % of its height, burnt is its paint blackened.

Driver's eye

From each car's EYE_driver: the dashboard, the wheel (STEER_wheel) and the speedometer needle (NEEDLE_speed), which the game turns from the simulation.
